summary: Notification destinations follow-ups: per-rule routing, custom-field templating, and cleanup of the now-vestigial global Alert Notification Fields card. (1) Per-rule routing — each detection rule can choose which destinations its alerts go to, stored as ruleConfig.destinations (empty = all). Backend: VisionAlertOptions.RuleDestinations filters the per-destination delivery loop; resolved via ruleDestinationsByID (monitor) and the exported services.ParseRuleDestinations (manual-alert API ruleInfo). UI: a 'Notification routing' panel in the rule editor lists configured destinations as checkboxes (none = all); helpers ruleDestinationsFromConfig/applyRuleDestinations preserve the routing across mode/target/line/crowd edits; destinations threaded App.js → VisionTab (loaded on app init). (2) Custom-field templating — custom field VALUES may use {{token}} placeholders ({{ruleName}}, {{cameraName}}, {{label}}, {{confidence}}, {{detectionType}}, {{alertId}}, {{ruleId}}, {{cameraId}}) expanded per alert via expandTemplate/alertTemplateContext in mergeCustomFields; unknown tokens expand to empty. UI hint lists the tokens. (3) Cleanup — removed the global 'Alert Notification Fields' card from Settings → AI (delivery is now per-destination); its now-unused handlers and the dead alertNotificationFields service/API methods were removed.
compatibility: Backward compatible. Rules with no ruleConfig.destinations route to all destinations (unchanged). Custom field values without {{ }} are untouched. The removed global field config no longer affects anything (per-destination fields supersede it); the runtime vision.alertNotification value remains stored but unused.
